partner.use: Applied the exact half-barrier packet s_2(C)>=499/8000.

supporting_source.use: Applied k=1 cap sqrt(e) and k=2 cap e to original-coordinate differences.

new_result.statement: If an original-coordinate cross block C has s_2(C)>=beta, then with arbitrary self blocks and outside couplings P(X^TAX in I)<=min(1,sqrt(2 e sqrt(pi)/beta)|I|^(1/2)).

route_counterexample.statement: For iid U[0,1], Q=(X1-Y1)(X2-Y2) has s_2(cross)=1/2 but unbounded density p_Q(t)>=(1/4)log(1/(4t)); its matrix spectrum is {1,-1,0,0}, so it refutes only free rank-two-bank payment, not the three-eigenvalue target.

first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-THIRD-DIRECTION-UPGRADE-v1: under s_3(A)>=1 plus s_2(A[L,R])>=499/8000, use the third spectral direction source-validly to upgrade the proved h^(1/2) concentration to a universal linear concentration bound.
